Download one file and double-click it. Nothing to install.

- **Windows:** `label-condense.exe`. Windows will warn that it is
  unsigned — choose **More info → Run anyway**.
- **Linux:** `label-condense`. Run `chmod +x label-condense` once.
  Needs glibc 2.35 or newer (Ubuntu 22.04+).
- **Mac:** `LabelCondense-mac.zip` (Apple Silicon, macOS 14.8 Sonoma or newer).
  Unzip it and drag **Label Condense** into Applications. It is
  unsigned, so the first open is refused: open **System Settings →
  Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway**.

Bundles Ghostscript (AGPL) and Poppler (GPL) — see NOTICE.md.
